title: Account
subtitle: Your profile, security settings and current sign-in state

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: You maintain these details yourself; an administrator can adjust them further under Administration
profile.usernameHint: The username cannot be changed. Contact an administrator if you need a different one.
profile.ssoUserHint: This account is managed by the SSO provider; its password and two-factor authentication are controlled externally.
profile.permissionsHint: The effective set merged from your user account and your group memberships.
profile.noPermissions: This account has not been granted any permissions.

password.title: Change password
password.subtitle: Your current session stays valid; other sessions must sign in again
password.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match
password.tooShort: The new password must be at least {min} characters
password.sameAsCurrent: The new password must differ from the current one

strength.label: Password strength
strength.hintMix: Mix upper and lower case letters, numbers and symbols

totp.title: Two-factor authentication (TOTP)
totp.subtitle: Use an authenticator app to generate one-time codes and add a second layer of defense to your account
totp.step1: Step 1 · Scan the QR code or enter the secret manually
totp.step1Hint: Scan the QR code with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or any similar app. If you cannot scan it, type the secret key below by hand.
totp.step2: Step 2 · Enter a code to finish setup
totp.step2Hint: Enter the 6-digit code currently shown in your app.
totp.disableHint: Once disabled, sign-in no longer asks for a code and your account is less protected.
totp.invalidCode: That code is incorrect. Make sure your device clock is synchronized.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.subtitle: Long-lived access tokens for scripts and automation integrations
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.nameHint: Used to tell tokens apart in the list. It cannot be changed after creation.

revealOnce.title: Save your token now
revealOnce.body: The token is shown only once. After you close this it cannot be viewed again — if you lose it, create a new one.

tokens.deleteConfirm: Delete the token “{name}”? Scripts using it stop working immediately.

loginWithToken.title: Sign in with an API token
loginWithToken.body: If you already have a long-lived token, paste it to sign in without a password.

sessions.title: My sessions
sessions.subtitle: Every active session for this account across all devices. Revoke one immediately if it looks suspicious.
sessions.revokeConfirm: Revoke this session? That device is signed out immediately.
sessions.revokeOthersConfirm: Revoke every session except this device?

server.title: DNS server
server.upToDate: You are on the latest version

console.title: This console
console.description: A modern administration interface redesigned for Technitium DNS Server. It reaches the upstream API through a server-side proxy, and tokens are kept in httpOnly cookies that browser scripts cannot read.

credits.title: Credits
credits.body: This project builds on the public HTTP API of Technitium DNS Server and is independent of the upstream project. DNS Server is copyright Technitium.
